item.title: Show HN: If you lose your memory, how to regain access to your computer?
item.description:
📝 This is a tool that encrypts files and splits the decryption key among trusted friends using Shamir's Secret Sharing. Each friend receives a self-contained bundle with recover. Your file is encrypted, the key is split into shares, and friends combine shares to recover it.
🔗 Read more: https://eljojo.github.io/rememory/

item.title: Show HN: BioTradingArena – Benchmark for LLMs to predict biotech stock movements
item.description:
📝 Given a press release about a biotech catalyst event, predict the likely stock price impact. Impact categories: - "very_positive": Stock likely to rise >15% (major positive catalyst like FDA approval, breakthrough Phase 3 results) - "positive": Stock likely to rise 5-15% (good results, positive regulatory news) - "slightly_positive": Stock likely to rise 2-5% (mixed but net positive news) - "neutral": Stock likely to move <2% either direction (expected results, minor news) - "slightly_negative": Stock likely to fall 2-5% (mixed but net negative news) - "negative": Stock likely to fall 5-15% (missed endpoints, regulatory setbacks) - "very_negative": Stock likely to fall >15% (major failures, safety issues, CRLs) Be CONSERVATIVE in your assessments. User promptAnalyze this biotech press release and predict the stock price impact.
🔗 Read more: https://www.biotradingarena.com/hn

item.title: NIMBYs aren't just shutting down housing
item.description:
📝 The complaint alleges that you [and] Yimby Law writes letters to CA cities threatening legal action and stating incorrect housing laws and city ordinance laws. As part of our work, YIMBY Law sends letters to cities in California that remind them of their obligations under state laws like the Housing Accountability Act. You shouldn’t do that.
